description: Implementation of roadmap_v3.md Feature 1: Set up local PostgreSQL database, implement Orion as direct LLM agent, and create Aider adapter with JSON extraction.

subtasks.title: Install and configure local PostgreSQL
subtasks.description: Install PostgreSQL using Docker or native installation, configure authentication, create database user, set up network settings for local access.

subtasks.title: Create database schema
subtasks.description: Execute backend/db/schema.sql to create tables (subtasks, subtask_state, subtask_logs), add indexes, set up foreign key relationships.

subtasks.title: Migrate data from Neon or initialize fresh
subtasks.description: Export data from Neon database, transform JSON structure to match schema, import to local PostgreSQL, verify data integrity.

subtasks.title: Update backend configuration
subtasks.description: Update .env file with local connection string, modify backend/db.js to use local database, test connection, implement error handling.

features.title: Implement Orion as Direct LLM Agent

subtasks.title: Create Orion database tools
subtasks.description: Build database read/write functions for Orion context, implement subtask creation and status update tools, create context aggregation from database and files.

subtasks.title: Integrate DeepSeek API with prompt templates
subtasks.description: Set up DeepSeek API integration, create prompt templates for planning and CDP, implement conversation management with database logging.

subtasks.title: Build Orion wrapper with database tool calling
subtasks.description: Create tool schema for database operations, implement tool calling in Orion wrapper, add error handling for failed tool executions.

subtasks.title: Test end-to-end planning workflow
subtasks.description: Test Orion planning with database interaction, verify CDP analysis identifies constraints accurately, ensure planning completes within 2 minutes.

features.title: Create Aider Adapter with JSON Extraction

subtasks.title: Build Aider CLI wrapper with timeout handling
subtasks.description: Create module to execute Aider commands programmatically, implement context passing, add timeout and error handling for long-running commands.

subtasks.title: Implement JSON extraction layer with validation
subtasks.description: Create natural language JSON parsing utilities, add validation against expected schemas, implement retry logic for failed JSON parsing.

subtasks.title: Integrate with database status change hooks
subtasks.description: Create webhook system for database status changes, map status values to Aider execution modes (Tara/Devon), implement result logging back to database.

subtasks.title: Test Tara → Devon → Tara execution cycle
subtasks.description: Test complete Aider execution cycle, verify JSON extraction success rate >90%, ensure results logged to database automatically.

success_criteria: Local PostgreSQL running with <100ms query times
All subtask data accessible via REST API
Migration from Neon completed without data loss
Orion can create subtasks in database via LLM calls
Aider adapter successfully executes code tasks
Status changes trigger appropriate agent execution
